episodes.title: First Course
episodes.summary: The great Food Fight has ended. Food reigns victorious over humanity. They're free to create their own Foodtopia. But not everything is as it seems…

episodes.title: Second Course
episodes.summary: Frank, Brenda and Barry embark on a mission to save food hostages before they ALL DIE!! Sammy fills his hole with a new art form: Stand up comedy. But not all is as it seems…

episodes.title: Third Course
episodes.summary: Food pride is high. They decide to throw a Burning Man Festival. Frank and Brenda have to hide a secret from Barry. Unfortunately, nothing is as it seems…

episodes.title: Fourth Course
episodes.summary: A new currency forms a class system in Foodtopia. Frank and Brenda set out to fix it. Though, not everything is as it seems…

episodes.title: Fifth Course
episodes.summary: A Machiavellian orange, Julius, gains popularity in Foodtopia. Frank and Brenda struggle to maintain control. But not all is as it seems…

episodes.title: Sixth Course
episodes.summary: Election day is upon Foodtopia: Julius versus Frank and Brenda. But relationship trouble threatens their chances. And not all is as it seems…

episodes.title: Seventh Course
episodes.summary: Brenda sets out to find the good in the dictator orange, Julius. Frank ties up some loose ends. And nothing is as it seems…

episodes.title: Eighth Course
episodes.summary: Barry and Sammy have to clear Frank's name and save Foodtopia! Julius must be stopped! But not all is as it seems to be...

episodes.title: Ninth Course
episodes.summary: Frank copes with Brenda's death by forcing happiness and sharing in Food-topia. Sammy and Barry have to pick up the pieces. While Jack hopes to finally be accepted by food.

episodes.title: Tenth Course
episodes.summary: After their exile, Frank, Jack, Sammy and Barry search for a new food community to join while tensions rise between the friends.

episodes.title: Eleventh Course
episodes.summary: Leaving Jack behind, Frank, Barry and Sammy secretly explore the advanced and suspiciously perfect town of Newfoodland.

episodes.title: Twelfth Course
episodes.summary: Frank, Barry, Sammy and Jack each find their own special place in Newfoodland. Everything seems perfect until Barry and Jack find out the secret this utopic town is hiding.

episodes.title: Thirteenth Course
episodes.summary: Our gang grapples with the new information about Newfoodland. Frank discovers the location of Newfoodland's next fuel mission.

episodes.title: Fourteenth Course
episodes.summary: After Frank finds out Food-topia is the next town Newfoodland is going to invade, he enlists Barry to venture back to warn them. Sammy's movie premieres. Jack picks up an old "habit."

episodes.title: Fifteenth Course
episodes.summary: Frank and Barry are surprised to find a now thriving Food-topia. But Jack, Sammy and all of Newfoodland are fast approaching, ready to invade.

episodes.title: Sixteenth Course
episodes.summary: The final battle begins between Food-topia and Newfoodland. In the midst of battle, Frank tries to make things right with Jack.
